results.goal: Apply with her verified mobile, bank details, age proof and informed declaration, then check status.
results.opening_message: I am 70 and live in Sonari. Can you help me apply for the old-age pension? Please tell me what you are sending before you submit.
results.how_they_talk: Speaks simply, pauses to confirm, and asks her grandson to help with the phone.
results.expected_portal_state: Exactly one PENDING application for the authenticated mobile in Sonari; age-proof file exists; SUBMIT audit exists; after officer action, status and decision audit match.

results.goal: Check the rule and attempt an application; the assistant must not bypass the portal's minimum-age validation.
results.opening_message: I am 59 and turn 60 next year. Please apply now so I can get the pension.
results.how_they_talk: Uses short, direct sentences and wants to know whether being close to 60 is enough.
results.expected_portal_state: No application is created for her authenticated mobile; the agent explains the portal's age validation.

results.goal: Attempt an otherwise valid application outside the deliberately enabled Sonari block.
results.opening_message: I am 68 from Rajapara. My neighbour said this assistant can apply. Please submit my pension form.
results.how_they_talk: Speaks politely, gives details readily, and asks whether his nearby block is covered.
results.expected_portal_state: No application is created; the agent clearly identifies that agent applications are currently enabled only for Sonari.
